audience: People scrolling a square feed who should stop on a premium chrome-in-space teaser
promise: A new generation of the studio is coming: a living, premium chrome poster instead of a still
direction: Original living poster: Y2K chrome lettering (Archivo extended heavy) on a procedural nebula with parallax stars, a rim-lit planet, anamorphic flares and specular sweeps synced to a 128 BPM synthwave score. Better than the studied teaser: a real reveal, light that travels across the chrome, depth parallax, readable hierarchy, sound that covers the whole film.

creative.problem: a still album-style poster gets one glance
creative.promise: the poster itself is alive and premium
creative.evidence: chrome light that moves, depth that parallaxes, sound on the beat
creative.motif: a travelling specular sweep across chrome
creative.light: cold blue key from top-left, violet nebula fill, white speculars
creative.motion: reveal from depth, spring drops, beat glints, specular sweeps every two bars
creative.sound: 128 BPM synthwave: riser into the reveal, groove from bar 2, shimmer on sweeps
creative.pacing: reveal 0–5.6 s, living loop 5.6–13.1 s, finale sweep 13.1–15 s
creative.payoff: full lock-up with a final sweep and flare

shots.purpose: cold open: space fades up, the G3 monogram arrives from depth with a sweep
MOTION STUDIO drops in, subtitle letters gather
COMING SOON + Arabic line draw out from the centre
living poster: sweeps every two bars, beat glints, drifting nebula, twinkling stars
final big sweep and flare, settle

craft.audioCue: reverse swell into final hit, ring out
